_comment: GOLDEN VECTORS for problem_signature (Sprint 83 T2, interface I3).
Pinned raw -> normalized -> symptom_hash -> class triples. BOTH repos run these:
mnestra (engram/tests/problem-signature.test.ts) and TermDecks server suite, which
vendors src/problem_signature_core.cjs. If the two ever disagree, a symptom written
by one side stops matching a lookup from the other and the solved-problem recall
path silently returns nothing forever - so a divergence must fail a test, loudly.
Editing the normalizer INVALIDATES these hashes and every stored signature: bump
PROBLEM_SIGNATURE_VERSION and regenerate deliberately, never to make a test pass.
